rounds.q: US safety code caps escalator speed. How many feet per minute is the limit?
rounds.why: That is about 1.1 mph. A normal walking pace is about 270 feet per minute, nearly 3 times as fast.
rounds.src: ASME A17.1 safety code sec. 6.1.4.1, via California Energy Code compliance manual 10.11
rounds.fun: Just 100 feet a minute, about 1.1 mph. The mall escalator is in no hurry!

rounds.q: What year was a barcode first scanned at a store checkout?
rounds.why: The first item was a 10-pack of gum. Barcodes now get scanned over 10 billion times a day.
rounds.src: GS1 US, 50-Year Barcode Scanniversary (first scan June 26, 1974)
rounds.fun: Beep! One 10-pack of gum in 1974, over 10 billion beeps a day now.

rounds.q: Over Thanksgiving weekend 2025, how much did the average shopper spend?
rounds.why: The exact figure was $337.86. Clothing and accessories were the top gift, bought by 51%.
rounds.src: National Retail Federation, Thanksgiving weekend survey (2025 data)
rounds.fun: About $338 each, and 51% bought clothing or accessories. Cozy!

rounds.q: How many Americans shopped from Thanksgiving to Cyber Monday in 2025?
rounds.why: A record 202.9 million. Black Friday alone sent 80.3 million people into stores.
rounds.src: National Retail Federation, Thanksgiving weekend survey (2025 data)
rounds.fun: A record 203 million shoppers. That is one very long checkout line!

rounds.q: How many different items does a typical US supermarket carry?
rounds.why: The average store is 42,272 square feet, and the average trip rings up $49.06.
rounds.fun: 33,248 items in 42,272 square feet. Good luck finding the milk!
